observation.command:
# Kill all dev server serve process groups
for pid in 85594 76004 78447; do kill -TERM -- -$pid 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 10
# ensure no lingering vite/nx build procs holding ports
ps aux | grep -E "run-executor|nx.js|vite" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null
sleep 5
for p in 38489 45423 43781 44689 37483 43025; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
# Set ports.json to match the nginx.conf rendered by the last 'just up --detach'
cat > /workspace/.urbo/workspace/ports.json <<'EOF'
{
  "app": 38489,
  "cms": 45423,
  "boards": 43781
}
EOF
cat /workspace/.urbo/workspace/ports.json
free -m | sed -n '2p'
